title: Roof Replacement in Gresham, OR
summary: In January 2025, French Roofing wrapped up a roof replacement across 29 townhome units in Gresham, OR. The crew tore off every layer of old roofing down to the wood deck, laid new synthetic underlayment, and installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with new valley metal, flashings, roof vents and ridge cap.
scope: Tore off all layers of the old roofing on 29 townhome units, down to the wood deck
Installed new synthetic underlayment, painted drip edge and gable flashing, and self-sealing starter shingles
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark shingles with 24 inch valley metal
New front wall and sidewall flashing, plus new double-seal flashings on the vent pipes
Replaced the attic vents and capped the ridges with standard ridge cap
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard
body: This was a bigger one: a whole row of townhome roofs, done section by section. The photos follow the work from the tear-off, through the new underlayment, to new shingles and ridge cap going on.

faqs.question: Did the old roofing come off on these Gresham townhomes?
faqs.answer: Yes. All layers of the old roofing came off down to the wood deck before the new underlayment and shingles went on.

faqs.question: What shingles went on?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark shingles, over synthetic underlayment, with new valley metal, flashings, attic vents and ridge cap.
